author: ruixen.ui
name: flexi-filter-table
description: This Super Mega Filter component is designed to provide a clean yet powerful way to filter large sets of data. Built with shadcn UI, it combines dropdowns, checkboxes, and keyword search in a plain, minimal layout that makes it both practical and reusable. The component is highly configurable—you can easily add, remove, or customize filter categories such as status, category, and date range without touching the core structure. Its lightweight design ensures it blends seamlessly into dashboards, admin panels, or job portals without looking overdone, while still giving users precise control over narrowing down results. By prioritizing usability over fancy styling, this filter is ideal for real-world applications where clarity and efficiency matter most.
